Billing Dispute Resolution Policy

Document ID: Policy_C04_billing_disputes

Category: C04 — Billing & Invoices

Department: Billing

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

Defines the framework for customers to dispute billed charges and the timelines for resolution.

2. Policy Statements

Disputes must be raised within 90 days of the relevant bill's generation date.

Standard disputes are targeted for resolution within 5-7 working days; complex usage investigations may take up to 15 working days.

Charges under active dispute are not sent to external collections until resolution.

3. Customer Rights

Customers dissatisfied with the dispute outcome may escalate per SOP_C16_COMPLAINT_ESCALATION, and ultimately to TRAI or a consumer forum.
